correctness.rationale: Cumulative flow after subtracting the sample mean gives B=H^T H and the discrete bridge covariance K(j,l)=min(j,l)-jl/n. In the trace-square sum, grouping by the larger index l gives (n-l)^2 l(2l^2+1)/(3n^2); summing and subtracting the squared diagonals in the off-diagonal Rademacher variance identity recovers the stated variance and factor 4/5. For k plus signs, double-centered distances give a strictly convex function of the ordered locations, so only the endpoint-block vertices of the location polytope can maximize. Relative to the all-prefix vertex, shifting q plus signs past the r=n-k minus signs increases the row-mean contribution to a^T B a by k p q r/n and increases the subtracted pair-distance sum by p q r. Thus the deficit in Z is 4pqr^2/n. The one-switch energy is 2k(n-k)(2k(n-k)+1)/(3n); maximizing its product yields both parity formulas and exactly the listed patterns. Zero means each centered flow is zero. For the interpolated bridge, the integral of its square differs from the discrete normalized energy by at most 2/(3n), since successive scaled increments have magnitude at most 2/sqrt(n). Donsker and the continuous mapping theorem give the limit; the stated KL eigenvalues are those of the Dirichlet Green operator. Independent exact integer enumeration counted 2044 vectors for n=2 through 10 and also verified the pseudoinverse equation. Independent averaging divides the variance by m.
